targets.rawSql:
SELECT  
  concat(reqHost,reqPath) AS url,
  ${cnt_all_var} AS count,
  ${offload_var} AS offload,
  ${avg_totalBytes_var} AS avgBytes,
  ${cached_turnAroundTimeMSec_var} AS cachedTurnAroundTimeMSec,
  ${uncached_turnAroundTimeMSec_var} AS uncachedTurnAroundTimeMSec,
  ${cached_transferTimeMSec_var} AS cachedTransferTimeMSec,
  ${uncached_transferTimeMSec_var} AS uncachedTransferTimeMSec, 
  (uncachedTurnAroundTimeMSec-cachedTurnAroundTimeMSec)+(uncachedTransferTimeMSec-cachedTransferTimeMSec) AS totalImprovement,
  (1-(cachedTurnAroundTimeMSec+cachedTransferTimeMSec)/(uncachedTurnAroundTimeMSec+uncachedTransferTimeMSec)) AS totalPercentImprovement,
  reqHost,
  reqPath
FROM ${table}
  WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
   AND $__adHocFilter()
   AND isNotNull(reqHost)
   AND reqHost NOT IN '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
   AND reqPath NOT IN '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
GROUP BY url,reqHost,reqPath
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Caching Impact ; du=${__user.login}'

options.content:
Using Cache Analysis Treemap Dashboard

Usage Overview

The Cache Analysis Treemap dashboard helps users quickly find and remediate caching issues:
  1. In the 'Summary' panels, use the 'lineChartGrouping' variable to decide how you'd like to see the data grouped. Then drag a rectangle around a time period of interest to 'zoom in' to that time period. Usually, select no more than 6 to 24 hrs time period.
    • Use the 'lineChartGrouping' filter to select what the different lines are (hostname, statusCode, country etc)
    • You can apply filters from the top and they will apply to the line chart. For example, if you're set to 'lineChartGrouping of 'hostname' and you filter to 'statusCode=500' you will see the count per hostname of all the 500 errors
    • Filters for high cardinality items like 'Path', 'User Agent', 'Query String' and 'Referrer' will not apply to the summary panels.
  2. After you've 'zoomed in', expand the other 'rows' in the dashboard to use the raw data panels for deeper analysis.
    • For the Treemaps, color coding indicates caching level measured as 'edge caching' (what percent of requests were available to serve from the dge cache)
      • Green : 90%
      • Yellow: 80%-90%
      • Orange : 70%-80%
      • Red : <60^
    • In some situations a resource may be available in the edge cache, even though edge cache is not used (such as if authentication is required to serve the resource)

Summary Tables

The top two panels in the dashboard are using 'Summary' tables. Summary tables have pre-aggregated counts for a variety of dimensions which allow for fast querying and querying over longer time periods. Summary tables are pre-aggregated using the following dimensions:
  • Hostname
  • Country
  • State
  • City
  • Status Code
  • Error Code
  • Request Method
  • Content Type
  • Protocol
  • Cache Status
  • CP Code

Raw Data Tables

Most Error Analysis dashboard panels use the raw data tables, which contains around 100 available data fields for every Akamai request. Field definitions are available here

Legend:
  • Green: General Data Stream Field
  • Purple: Requires 'BreadCrumbs' behavior in property
  • Blue: Only available for streaming medai which applies cmcd headers

FAQ

  • Can I add fields to TrafficPeak?

  • Yes. You can pass up to 1000 characters into the custom field. This would allow you to pass in various values. You can parse out the values in SQL

  • Can I get an overview of the fields and sample values

  • Yes. Open the 'Explore Data' Dashboard. Select the table 'logs' for DS2 data or 'SIEM' for SIEM data. Click on a field name to see sample values. Click the '+/-' fields next to a value to filter to just that value.

  • How do I make sure the 'rows' are collapsed when I open the dashboard?

  • Collapse all the rows except for the 'summary' row. Then save the dashboard and select the option 'Save current dashboard variables as dashboard default'.

All TrafficPeak VIDS

Video Description
TrafficPeak Error Analysis Video (here) (10 min) An overview on how to use the Error Analysis Dashboard to find errors that users are experiencing when requesting content.
Cache & URL Analysis Video (here) (14 min) An overview on how to use TrafficPeak to identify resources which are having low caching rates.
Creating and Customizing TrafficPeak Dashboards Video (here) (37 min) An overview on how to create and customize TrafficPeak Dashboards.
Sending DataStream data to TrafficPeak (here) (10 min) An overview on how to set Akamai DataStream and properties to send data to TrafficPeak.

    WHEN '${table}' = '${ds2}' AND '${aggregation}' = 'P95' THEN 'quantileIf(0.95)(transferTimeMSec, cacheStatus=0)'
    WHEN '${table}' = '${ds2}' AND '${aggregation}' = 'P99' THEN 'quantileIf(0.99)(transferTimeMSec, cacheStatus=0)'
    WHEN '${table}' IN ('${summary_hour}','${summary_day}') AND '${aggregation}' = 'avg' THEN 'avg_uncached_transferTimeMSec'
    WHEN '${table}' IN ('${summary_hour}','${summary_day}') AND '${aggregation}' = 'Median' THEN 'quantiles_uncached_transferTimeMSec[2]'
    WHEN '${table}' IN ('${summary_hour}','${summary_day}') AND '${aggregation}' ='P75' THEN 'quantiles_uncached_transferTimeMSec[3]'
    WHEN '${table}' IN ('${summary_hour}','${summary_day}') AND '${aggregation}' ='P90' THEN 'quantiles_uncached_transferTimeMSec[4]'
    WHEN '${table}' IN ('${summary_hour}','${summary_day}') AND '${aggregation}' ='P95' THEN 'quantiles_uncached_transferTimeMSec[5]'
    WHEN '${table}' IN ('${summary_hour}','${summary_day}') AND '${aggregation}' ='P99' THEN 'quantiles_uncached_transferTimeMSec[6]'
  END
